summary_1line: Indra, disguised as a Brahmana, obtains Karna’s divine armor and earrings in exchange for a one‑use spear after Karna willingly cuts them from his own body.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna calmly slices the natural armor from his own chest as gods shower flowers and celestial drums thunder in the sky.
Indra, revealed in divine radiance, receives Karna’s blood‑dripping armor and earrings while handing him the blazing Vasavi spear.
Celestial beings, men, and demons watch in awe as Karna smiles while cutting the armor from his body.
